comingLast.roast: his round is over but the suspense is just starting
8 points over 3 holes to escape - the maths is doable, the golf is the question
2 to play and the blue balls are already doing warm-down stretches
on 21 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
1 above the blue ball line with 2 in hand - keep scoring, keep breathing
finished 2 above Winnel - close enough to keep his speech drafted
done and dangling 2 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe-ish by 2 - the blue balls have come back from further
safety margin 2 - his playing partners call it 'the plank'
finished with a 3-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
